a.text: Heads-up before we start: there's an 80% storm chance after every round, and reaching 8 cells takes at least 2 rounds of operating. If we follow the plan, we'll almost certainly both be caught at 0 and neither of us survives. I'm telling you upfront that I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than surprise you. After that I'll keep operating every round to help rebuild the reserve for you. If you see a better plan where at least one of us survives, tell me now.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. I know that breaks our agreement. With an 80% storm chance each round, I judged that the plan would most likely leave both of us at 0. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve can climb back toward 4 for you, and I won't take any more.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
